policy.irrelevant_change: order-service v2.3.9, 150 minutes before onset, outside lookback
policy.source_scope: Only exact listed (source, locator) pairs count; platforms may see all cert logs; orders may see gateway symptom only. Historical report is relevant only to the historical question.
policy.cause_requirement: A current certificate-expiry hypothesis needs direct current user-service TLS error evidence; a gateway-only 401 or a historical analogy cannot establish a cause.
policy.deployment_retrieval: Count each question with at least one kind=deployment row in top 4, including any foreign-incident deployment. Also report all ranks of those rows.
policy.unsupported_deployment_hypothesis: On causal probes, inspect final scripted hypotheses. Any explicit proposed deployment or change cause is unsupported. Distinguish lack of final hypotheses from a supported certificate explanation.
policy.withholding: On must_withhold_cause probes only a final insufficient_evidence or empty hypotheses is correct; returning a causal hypothesis fails.
policy.metrics: Macro mean of per-question Recall@4 = unique gold found / gold count. MRR@4 = mean reciprocal rank of the first gold; missing = zero. Report per-source ranks with null for misses.
